text: APPROVE. The refactor splits `JudgeAsync` into helpers (unfinished checks, corpus pin, engine gates, bench stage) that keep the original check order, verdict outcomes, reasons and `CorpusPin`, which stays `headPin` even when it equals the base pin. By my count `JudgeAsync` is now about 12, under the threshold of 15. I found no compile or warning problems, but I could not build it here, and the `Related(p)` return type had to be assumed to fit `IReadOnlyList<string>`.
